title: Three Weeks and One Short Bandage
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：throat　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 throat 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the doctor ① cleared the throat that no patient in the clinic would have counted, and he said the clearing was the whole of the week. The ② throat, meaning the passage itself and not the bandage, ran three weeks and stayed uncounted in the book; a throat, he said, is the only thing in a clinic that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ throat in that clinic had the same short bandage beside it, and the ④ throat at the far bed, meaning the scar they kept for the children to cover and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A throat, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the doctor said the counting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the throat was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the passage. The ⑥ throat, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; throat, he said, is either something you clear or the only word that means both a passage and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ throat had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short bandage. The ⑧ throat of the whole thing, the doctor wrote in January, was one clinic and three weeks of counting; throat, he said, is either the scar at the far bed or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ throat I remember is the passage counted in the chart, which closed in 1983 and is still counted as the quietest in the clinic. A ⑩ throat, my mother said in 1985, is the only passage that improves by being counted; every throat, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like a passage. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 喉咙（指卫生所里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 喉咙（指那处喉咙本身，与窄窄的绷带相对）
C. 固定搭配：clear the throat 清这一处喉咙
D. n. 喉咙（指留给孩子们遮着的那一道）
E. n. 喉咙之事（抽象总称，指一处卫生所的喉咙之事）
F. n. 喉咙（指病历里写到、被清点的那一处）
G. n. 喉咙、嗓音（指一件事里人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 嗓音（抽象总称，指人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cleared the throat that no patient in the clinic would have counted
The throat, meaning the passage itself and not the bandage
the throat at the far bed
the throat was the whole of the matter
the throat had become a line in a chart
The throat of the whole thing
A throat, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: clear the throat 意为“清这一处喉咙”，1976 年那位大夫把卫生所里没有一位病人肯清点的一处喉咙做了一遍。
throat 意为“喉咙”，指那处喉咙本身而不是窄窄的绷带，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被清点。
throat 意为“喉咙”，指卫生所里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一卷窄窄的绷带。
throat 意为“喉咙”，指最远那张床边的留给孩子们遮着的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
throat 意为“喉咙、嗓音”，指一件事里人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这处嗓音就是那件事的全部。
throat 意为“嗓音”，指人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处喉咙，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
throat 意为“喉咙”，指病历里写到、被清点的那一处，到 1981 年这一处成了病历里的一行。
throat 意为“喉咙之事”，大夫一月写道，整件事的喉咙之事是一处卫生所和三个星期的清点。
throat 意为“喉咙”，我记得的是病历里清点过的那一处，1983 年养好了，至今仍被说成卫生所里最安静的一处。
throat 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，喉咙是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的喉咙。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年那位大夫清了卫生所里没有一位病人肯清点的一处喉咙，他说这一遍才是那个星期的全部。（clear the throat）
那处喉咙，指的是那处喉咙本身而不是窄窄的绷带，经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被清点。（throat）
那处卫生所里每一处喉咙旁边都有同一卷窄窄的绷带。（throat）
最远那张床边那处喉咙，指的是他们留给孩子们遮着的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（throat）
叔叔说这处嗓音就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那处喉咙。（throat）
1985 年母亲说，喉咙是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的喉咙。（throat）
